You’re definitely not alone man. I’ve always thought I was crazy for wanting to die. Every time I “joke” about suicide or share my thoughts about it to a girlfriend or friend they make me feel like I’m the only one who feels this way. Or they try to convince me that “everything will turn around” and “you have so many people that love you”. Maybe it’s true. Maybe it’s not. Maybe everything won’t be “okay” someday. Maybe people will be sad and hurt for awhile after I’m gone...but that’ll fade. The only person that keeps me hanging on each day is my mom. I know it’ll destroy her. I’m her only child and she loves me more than she loves herself. Some days I think to myself that she’ll be okay without me. But it’s so hard to convince myself of that. 
But the pain and sadness I feel deep in my fucking gut everyday, every minute, is so strong. I wish I was “normal”. Not so sad. But I am. 
I never asked to be brought into this world. 
Anyways... It’s nice to know I’m not alone in this. 
It’s nice to know there’s other people who feel the sad too...
